title: Build an app from the dashboard

chapters.title: Build and test a preview from the dashboard
chapters.caption: The outcome is a working app with a tested filter, not just generated HTML or a screenshot.

chapters.title: No local CLI or SDK is needed
chapters.caption: Dashboard controls manage the workspace. OpenCode writes the app; Harakiri supplies terminal, files, routes and cleanup.

chapters.title: Create a workspace from the OpenCode template
chapters.caption: Use the OpenCode template. Add model configuration before Create sandbox; do not paste a Harakiri API key into the form.

chapters.title: Set the model configuration before creating
chapters.caption: Select Create sandbox. Wait for running and for Terminal to report attached before sending commands.

chapters.title: The full prompt: application behavior
chapters.caption: Three synthetic releases, a real select filter, a health endpoint, and Node standard library only.

chapters.title: The full prompt: quality and execution
chapters.caption: OpenCode must write files and execute tools. It must leave the server stopped so you control when the preview starts.

chapters.title: Paste the complete command into Terminal
chapters.caption: The command runs remotely. Do not close or kill the sandbox while the agent is writing files.

chapters.title: Inspect tool activity and model costs
chapters.caption: The recording contains completed file-writing and bash tools. Completed model steps reported cost 0.

chapters.title: Inspect the files the agent actually created
chapters.caption: Both requested files exist. A success message without files is not an accepted result.

chapters.title: Check and start the Node server
chapters.caption: Syntax passes and local health returns {"ok":true}. The app listens on 0.0.0.0:3000 for the route to reach it.

chapters.title: Expose only the application port
chapters.caption: Port 3000, HTTP, Public. The generated preview /health returned HTTP 200 and {"ok":true} in the capture.

chapters.title: Exercise the filter in the real preview
chapters.caption: Passed displays Portal only. All restores Portal, Search and Billing. Test behavior, not appearance alone.

chapters.title: Terminate and verify the preview is gone
chapters.caption: The UI Kill action terminated the recorded runtime, and the public route stopped serving the application.

editing: Real CLI output replay; condensed SDK excerpts; real UI recordings. Waiting removed. No speed benchmark or voiceover.
